cards.name: Ponyta
cards.description: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.description: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.description: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.description: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

cards.name: Krabby
cards.description: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.description: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.description: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.description: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.description: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from it mouth.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.description: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.description: It licks with its gaseous tongue to steal the victim's life force. It lurks in darkness for prey.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.description: Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.description: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.description: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.description: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.description: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

cards.name: Machop
cards.description: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.description: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.description: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.description: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.description: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

cards.name: Golem
cards.description: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.description: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.description: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.description: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.description: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.description: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Persian
cards.description: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.description: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.description: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.description: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Paras
cards.description: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.description: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.description: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.description: It swings its long antlers wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.description: Running around, climbing trees, playing hide-and-seek! Another wonderful day begins!

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.description: Crackle…buzz…Dedenne…?! Beep…

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.description: When she's surrounded by cushions and dressers that I like, she looks just like a princess!

cards.name: Gulpin
cards.description: When Mom gets in the kitchen, the happiest things happen. I can feel my mouth watering!

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.description: The twinkle of the stars. The destiny of love. A miracle that grants wishes in the night sky.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.description: My number one. Exceptionally cute. A little princess.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.description: Intense silence. Two lamplights. Keep waiting for night to end.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.description: Hidden away in its jet-black wings is a red passion.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.description: It's OK. No one will take away your flower. You look cute even when you're angry.

cards.name: Floette
cards.description: The five of us team up to be the Pretty Young Girl Force! We'll show you some beautiful moves!

cards.name: Swirlix
cards.description: My fluffy heart makes me feel like a marshmallow. A thrilling macaron full of colorful magic. Everybody's crazy about the taste of candy! ☆

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.description: I wonder if I would look a little cuter with a beautiful flower?

cards.name: Slurpuff
cards.description: The cakes Slurpuff makes always look just like that one Pokémon it likes.

cards.name: Diancie
cards.description: Open the magic door and a dream-colored party will start again today. I'll teach you the secret password.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.description: Wings and beaks. I like yours, and I like mine, too.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.description: This fluffiness makes everyone go crazy. Is it really that charming?

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.description: Little friends, thanks for always helping me look so cute!

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: A yellow body is proof of good health. If you touch its bright-red cheeks, you'll see its shining, smiling face!

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: My Charmander is so rambunctious! I wonder if we can become good friends?

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: My precious friend who is always with me. I have so many things I want to tell you.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.description: No matter what happens, if we stick together, we can get past it. Forever and ever.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.description: What a delicious-looking snowman! I think I'll sneak a bite. It's OK…no one's looking, right?

cards.name: Froslass
cards.description: Spring is already here, so goodbye…

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: The plan for today is to do nothing. My awesome tail is all curled up, and my ears are tired, too.
